a.text: 'Many Feared Dead After Major Originium Accident'

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: This way, please!

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Are you reflecting the official position when you refuse to comment?

steps.name: Rude Reporter
steps.text: This way! Look at the cameras!

steps.name: Rude Reporter
steps.text: Did you know about this beforehand?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Officer Jackie.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: The truth is right here! Answer the questions!
A little while ago...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: There you are, Jackie. I was looking for you.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Aren't you getting a little excited, Operator Jackie?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I'm sorry I'm sorry I'm sorry! Are you okay?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Are you hurt?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'm fine. But you ought to be careful.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Don't get yourself hurt before the award ceremony.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Look at you. Your clothes are all wrinkled now.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I'm fine, I'm fine.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: There!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Where did you run off to this time?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I sneaked off to the venue. They were pretty busy.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: So I helped them move the equipment onstage.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You went to help them?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Yeah! It was so heavy!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: When I stood onstage, it brought back memories of my dad getting honored.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I was watching from the crowd. Everyone around me was clapping, but I clapped the loudest.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: That's why dad always knew where I was sitting. His face was all serious, but he always flashed a smile at me.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Jackie? What's the matter?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: This time, I was the one up on the stage.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Too bad he was out on assignment and couldn't be there.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'm sure he's proud of you.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I'll tell Dad all about it later!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Before I forget, I need you to come with me.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The government folks say there's something they have to confirm with you before the ceremony.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: To charge into the scene without a second thought, saving so many people in the face of danger...

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Your heroism is admirable, Officer Jackie.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Actually, I was just an auxiliary...

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: No problem at all. We have talked to Rhodes Island about your situation.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Including your Oripathy.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: I understand that Rhodes Island has provided a full report on your condition?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Affirmative. Rhodes Island takes full responsibility for our operators' health.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Whatever guarantees you need, we'll give.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Well, it's no trouble, really, as long as there are no clearly visible signs.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: We have a contingency plan if someone wants to make something bigger of it than it is.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Contingency?

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: A young officer contracted Oripathy in the course of saving lives while off-duty.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: That will be the official explanation.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: But then...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: That's just the worst-case scenario. We'll try to avoid any unexpected issues.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: You'll always be an honored member of the Columbian Police Force, no matter what.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Just like your father.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I... I'm not like my father. He's the spirit of a true policeman.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Well, then, here's your chance.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Prove to your father that you're a hero, just like him.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Take this and read it.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: 'Were you thinking about your family when you rushed in?'

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: 'Your father is a police officer too. What did he think about your actions?'

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: 'How are you feeling now? Any lasting effects on work and everyday life?'

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Do I have to answer everything according to this sheet?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: I know you have questions. However...

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: You have to cultivate the best possible public image, so as not to disappoint your father.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Wouldn't you agree, Officer Jackie?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Officer...?

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Yes, Officer Jackie.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: That's you.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: This is an honor for the government, for the police force...

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: For you.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: And for your father.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I'll go and prepare.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll handle it!

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Let me introduce you to the representative of the people you rescued before the ceremony.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: He's very grateful and insists on conveying his gratitude in person.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Sure!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: My face is clean, right?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Just a heads-up, Jackie...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The government hasn't sent official notice to Rhodes Island about their intention to re-hire you to the police force.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It's possible that whatever that man said was just for publicity purposes.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: How are my clothes? Anything sticking out in the back?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Looking fine.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Did you hear what I said, Jackie? You're too nervous.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Yeah... but this is my first time on a stage.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I don't really know why...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: But I'm sure Dad will be in the audience.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: What if I say or do something wrong? He'll see right through me.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: But there are so many people down there, and I can't see him.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: What would be the look on his face?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Would he be disappointed?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I know I'm not worthy of the 'officer' title yet.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: It's okay if I can't get back onto the force.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Give me that sheet.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I want to do my best, like my dad sitting there.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Officer Jackie? The staff told me you were here.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: May I have a quick interview before the ceremony?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Here's my ID. I'm...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Excuse me, we're busy right now.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: There will be time for media questions at the ceremony.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: It'll just take a minute!

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: You were talking about a sheet. Is it the one you're holding? Sorry, I didn't mean to eavesdrop.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: It's just that... this is important.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Let's go, Jackie. Don't keep that guy waiting.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Hey, wait!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I'm sorry!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I'll answer at the ceremony!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (I've told everyone how amazing Dad is. Nothing gives him trouble, not catching bad guys, not saving lives.)

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (That's how the press has always reported on him. He's a model officer! Dad doesn't like it when I carry news clippings and photos of him with me, though.)

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (I know most of the people he helped.)

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (When they come to visit, they always tell me I should become an officer just like him. Dad would say that I'm just an auxiliary who still has a lot to learn.)

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (I've never actually seen all the medals he earned. I wonder why he never takes them home.)

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (This'll be the first medal in our house!)

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: Officer Jackie, right?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: I knew it! I could recognize you a mile away.

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: You probably don't recognize me! All our faces were covered in soot that day.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Oh, it's you!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Let me push your wheelchair.

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: Oh, I'm totally fine. Look!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I insist! Let me help.

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: Haha, okay, okay.

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: Thank you, Officer Jackie.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: This way, please, Mr. Mayor.

steps.name: Rude Reporter
steps.text: Can we take another, Mr. Mayor?

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Excuse me, Officer, could you stand closer to the mayor?

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: We need both of you in the shot, please.

steps.name: Rude Reporter
steps.text: Officer, please stand tall!

steps.name: Rude Reporter
steps.text: Could you straighten out your clothes, please?

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Officer Jackie, were you thinking about your family when you rushed in that day?

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: You know how dangerous it was, better than any of us here.

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Was there any hesitation in your heart?

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Come on, folks, Officer Jackie has been through a lot, and this is her first time getting honored. It's understandable that she would be a little nervous.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: One by one, please. No rush.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Her father is also an outstanding officer. He has stood exactly where she is right now.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: He was just as nervous as you are now!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Yes, I remember!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: It was many years ago, when Dad was just an ordinary officer at the local station.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: He was on duty...

a.text: If he's down there right now...

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Officer Jackie?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: It was my duty as a police officer.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I didn't have time, and the situation... didn't allow me to hesitate. Every second counted for the people trapped inside.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: The moment I rushed in...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I thought about my father, but even more so, his encouragement... and expectations.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: That hardened my resolve to help those trapped people.

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: You mentioned your father. What did he think about your actions?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: As a police officer, my father's duty is to his post.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Unfortunately, he could not be here today.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: But I'm sure he's proud of me.

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Is that why you joined the force?

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: To become a police, help others, and prove yourself to your father?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I didn't start helping people because I joined the force.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Just like my father, he...

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: May I interrupt?

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: I just want to say that, whether it's Officer Jackie or her father...

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: It makes average folks like us feel really safe to know that there are people like them protecting us, passing the torch from one generation to the next.

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: I'm also really grateful for the mayor's invitation, allowing me to thank my savior in person.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: The honor is all mine.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: It's my sincere hope that this spirit will be passed on not just in the police force, but throughout all departments of the government.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Let it inspire all of us public servants to truly be worthy of the name, to serve the people, lead by example, and protect our citizens.

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Photo, Officer Jackie. A little closer please.

steps.name: Rude Reporter
steps.text: Smile, officer.
Officer Jackie!
Officer Jackie!
Officer Jackie!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Don't worry, you could do a backflip here without anyone seeing you.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Oh!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I... I don't know!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Is this how things are?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Did Dad have to do this? Go along with everything they want...?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It's a show for the media, Jackie.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: They paint a picture for you, make you answer questions in a way that fits their public image.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You don't need any of these to prove yourself, though. Everyone at Rhodes Island knows your kindness and courage.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We all know your father is a true hero.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: If you really can't handle it... you can leave.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Rhodes Island will take care of the rest.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: No! I won't leave like this.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I'm not worried about the media or any honors.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I... I can do it! I'm serious!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Then what are you worried about?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: 'Become a true police officer, an example for my daughter and the people.'

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: All that I heard in the crowd...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Did he really think that way? Was that what he wanted me to hear?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You saved lives. That's a fact.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You earned this medal, whatever other plans they might have in mind.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Are you going back?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: On behalf of the government, the police force...

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: The persons rescued and their families...

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: I hereby confer the Medal of Outstanding Valor to Officer Jackie for her role in this rescue operation.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: May you continue to contribute to the city and its citizens as a representative of the government and the police force.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Mr. Mayor! Mr. Mayor!

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: I have a question!

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Who are you? Where's your media pass?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Officer Jackie.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: As the only person who was inside the accident site, do you recognize the people in this photo?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: I need an answer!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: These two were killed in the accident.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I tried to help them...

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: How many did you save?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Four.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Are they in the photo?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I'm not sure. It was a very chaotic situation. I didn't have time to look at their faces.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Then let me ask the rescued persons representative here. Do you recognize the people in the photo?

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: No, I don't.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: You don't? Really?

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Enough!

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Notify the police! Arrest this intruder!

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Hey, you have a hero cop right here. Get her to arrest me.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Another accolade to her record.

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Why you!

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Arrest him, Officer Jackie!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: No, go ahead.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Sure. Let's see how far we can take this.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: According to media reports, it was a family of seven that was involved in this accident. The cause was the family's second son, whose infection had progressed furthest, and certain things that the mayor would prefer no one talked about.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: I'm warning you!

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: The government has not made their identities public, but I managed to get a photo of the family, right here.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: You confirmed the two deceased and rescued four more, which makes seven together with the second son.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: But you, the rescued persons representative, don't recognize your own family?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: I just...

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: My family's fine! Why are you asking all this?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: What are you getting at?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: This man just survived a traumatic event.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: What are you getting at?!

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: This man was dismissed from the police force not long ago. This is his service record.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: But for some reason, I couldn't find any service record for you, Officer Jackie.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: No complaints, no commendations, no overtime.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: You just happened to show up, and be the only one to rush into the accident site, of all the officers on scene.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Oh, right, your father is a hero. What if the daughter of the hero is a hero too?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: The perfect story, isn't it? For Mr. Mayor's re-election campaign, and for the government's image, which hasn't been so squeaky-clean lately.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Your father is an outstanding police officer.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: But are you?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Are you a police officer at all?

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Officer Jackie!

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Are you reflecting the official position when you refuse to comment?

steps.name: Rude Reporter
steps.text: This way! Look at the cameras!

steps.name: Rude Reporter
steps.text: Did you know about this beforehand?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Jackie, I've contacted Rhodes Island. They're looking into it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Say nothing.

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Is he telling the truth, Mr. Mayor?

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Hogwash! This is pure fabrication, all of it!

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: He is trying to defame and slander our hero!

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Security! Get this man!

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Take him into custody!

steps.name: Government Official
steps.text: Hey! You?!

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Officer Jackie! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I have questions for this man. I won't let you take him away.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Get out of my way!

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: What do you want to ask?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: To tell the truth, I don't know what happened today.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I was just glad to see the man I rescued, safe and sound.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: But you tell me he's a fake, and this is all just a show?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Is it not?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I know that the accident wasn't fake.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: The people I saved... the people who died...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: None of that was fake.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Where are the people I rescued? The real ones?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: How could you not know?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Why are you asking me? How should I know why they can't be here?

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: Shouldn't you be asking the one who planned all this?

steps.name: Rescued Persons Representative
steps.text: I-I don't know anything. Don't ask me!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: What's going on, Mr. Mayor?

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Officer Jackie.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: This does not concern you. You've crossed a line.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Watch yourself. You're representing the police force, and your father.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Why did you rush in? Weren't you at all scared of all those terrorists?

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Some are claiming that your reckless actions sparked the terrorists' brutal response, resulting in harm to the victims. How do you respond?

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: I heard that your daughter was in the police as well. Would you want her to do the same, if it was you who was trapped inside?

steps.name: Father
steps.text: To be completely frank, I don't feel the need for these questions, or even for any reporting about this.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: But if I had to give an answer...

steps.name: Father
steps.text: I would never stand idly by and watch someone die, if there's anything I could do about it.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: But I'm not a police officer. That's my father.

steps.name: Independent Reporter
steps.text: So you admit it?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I'm not fit to represent my father.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: He's a true hero! Don't you dare doubt him!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: All I know right now is that four people have gone missing.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I saved their lives. They should be here, but they're not.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Where are they?!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Mr. Mayor.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Answer my question, or else...

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: O-Or else what?!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Oh, so this is the place?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I've looked into it. This is where the four people are.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: They were infected with Oripathy in the accident, so...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: So the government doesn't want them to show their faces in public, even in Columbia.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The cause of the accident isn't exactly something that the government wants to see come to light, after all.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: 'A young officer contracted Oripathy in the course of saving lives while off-duty.'

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: They'll think of a story, no matter what.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: That story just happened to be you, this time.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Will they be okay?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We'll work with the local government to ensure that they receive proper treatment.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Although the... incident... might have made things a little harder.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Oh no, I'm sorry!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It's not your fault.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You saved four lives at great risk to yourself soon after being assigned to Columbia.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The Doctor will be glad to hear it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Good work, Officer Jackie.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Oh, you kept the medal?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I still have to tell Dad the story, after all.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Hehe.
